topic: Conformal risk control, RCPS, Learn-then-Test and descendants applied to healthcare / clinical deployment, especially certified gates on when a model may answer
method_notes: WebSearch with fifteen query formulations; every candidate's abstract read via arXiv/publisher before classification (arXiv HTML fetched for SCoRE and the False-Sense-of-Safety audit to check shift type and exchangeability handling). Semantic Scholar API returned HTTP 429 on both attempts (no key), so coverage rests on WebSearch. paper/references.bib was grepped so that each entry below records whether the manuscript already cites it. VERDICT: no COLLISION. Nothing found combines site/cluster-as-unit exchangeability with a betting / e-value certificate on the answered-set error of a selective gate, label-shift correction with cluster-robust uncertainty, and multi-hospital clinical validation. The lane is crowded at the record level (SCoRE, SCRC, LEC, Yu-Liu joint certificate, Certify-or-Refuse) and site-level validity is being raised elsewhere (federated CRC, hierarchical multi-hospital conformal), but the two threads have not been joined. Three items a reviewer in this lane may expect and that references.bib does not yet carry: Certify-or-Refuse (arXiv 2608.10893, 11 Aug 2026), LEC (ICML 2026, arXiv 2512.01556), and Xu-Karampatziakis-Mineiro's anytime-valid betting RCPS (NeurIPS 2024).

papers.title: Conformal Selective Prediction with General Risk Control (SCoRE)
papers.why: Closest single object in the lane: e-value based selective prediction with finite-sample control of both marginal and selective (per-answered-unit) deployment risk, with ICU length-of-stay and clinical-error-management applications. Differences: record-level exchangeability (no site/cluster unit), risk-adjusted conformal e-values rather than a betting/test-martingale certificate, and only covariate shift (importance weighting) is handled -- label shift is not. ALREADY CITED in references.bib (score2026).

papers.title: Selective Conformal Risk Control (SCRC-T / SCRC-I)
papers.authors: Yunpeng Xu, Wenge Guo, Zhi Wei
papers.why: Two-stage abstain-then-CRC framework with exact finite-sample (SCRC-T) and PAC-style (SCRC-I) guarantees on the accepted subset. Overlaps component (2) as a certified answer/abstain gate; no cluster unit, no e-values/betting, no clinical data, no label shift. ALREADY CITED (scrc2025).

papers.title: A Joint Finite-Sample Certificate for Adaptive Selective Conformal Risk Control
papers.why: Single finite-sample certificate that jointly upper-bounds selected risk (empirical-Bernstein on the ratio), lower-bounds acceptance (Clopper-Pearson) and bounds utility, valid under adaptive threshold selection over a grid; benchmarks against a predictable-mixture betting confidence sequence. Overlaps the certified-gate component and the operative-rung/threshold-selection concern; record-level, vision datasets, no shift, no sites. ALREADY CITED (yu2026joint).

papers.title: False Sense of Safety in Selective Signal Classification: Auditing Bound Tightness and Exchangeability for Risk Control
papers.why: Audits selective-prediction risk control with Hoeffding, Clopper-Pearson and Waudby-Smith-Ramdas betting (WSR) upper confidence bounds; shows naive thresholding overruns its budget in 49-73% of trials, that CP/WSR certify coverage where Hoeffding certifies none, and that grouped deployment (unseen machine types / generators, i.e. calibration and test drawn from disjoint groups) breaks the record-level guarantee in 9-30% of trials. Recommends random-split negative controls -- overlaps components (2) and (5) and is the nearest published statement of the group-shift failure that motivates site-as-unit; but the groups are never made the unit of inference and there is no clinical data. ALREADY CITED (zhou2026falsesense).

papers.title: A Deployment Audit of Release-Side Risk in Conformal Triage under Prevalence Shift
papers.authors: Chengze Li, Xiao Liu, Hanrong Zhang, Haiyang Peng, Yanghao Ruan, Huanhuan Ma, Chunyu Miao, Qichao Zhou, Xiangrong Qi, Philip Yu
papers.why: Clinical conformal triage (release / flag / defer) audited under prevalence (label) shift with a three-way split for prevalence correction, conformal calibration and held-out release-side evaluation on an NSCLC cohort; finds too few event labels to sustain safe thresholds. Overlaps the label-shift-plus-gate combination and the honest-budget theme; single cohort, no site unit, no e-values/betting. ALREADY CITED (triage2026audit).

papers.title: When Average Calibration Fails: Site-Conditional Federated Conformal Risk Control (a.k.a. When Calibration Fails the Vulnerable Hospital: Federated CRC via Risk-Curve Shrinkage)
papers.why: Shows pooled federated CRC on FeTS-2022 (1,251 subjects, 20 institutions) protects the average hospital but violates the target at 40% of institutions (worst site +7.8 pp), proposes risk-curve shrinkage between site-specific and pooled calibration, and stresses that finite-sample corrections are essential. Nearest published multi-hospital statement of the aggregate-vs-individual-site signature CertGate labels in E1/E6; but sites are the calibration/reporting unit rather than the exchangeable unit of a certificate, no selective gate, no e-values, no label shift. ALREADY CITED (fedcrc2026).

papers.title: Conformal selective prediction with cost aware deferral for safe clinical triage under distribution shift
papers.why: Split conformal + Mondrian (gender-stratified) + importance-weighted variants with cost-aware deferral to clinicians for early sepsis prediction, evaluated on temporally separated in- and out-of-distribution splits; finite-sample coverage control, deferral of low-confidence cases. Same venue family and same clinical selective-prediction framing; record-level, single cohort, coverage rather than answered-error certificate, no e-values, no site unit. ALREADY CITED (scireports2026deferral).

papers.title: A hierarchical conformal framework for uncertainty-aware length of stay prediction in multi-hospital settings (arXiv: Adaptive Conformal Prediction via Bayesian Uncertainty Weighting for Hierarchical Healthcare Data)
papers.authors: Marzieh Amiri Shahbazi, Ali Baheri, Nasibeh Azadeh-Fard
papers.why: Group-aware conformal calibration plus Bayesian hierarchical uncertainty for LOS intervals over 61,538 patients from 3,793 hospitals; explicitly frames hospitals as the exchangeability-violating hierarchy. Overlaps component (1) as multi-hospital conformal in a clinical journal; regression intervals with empirical near-nominal coverage rather than a finite-sample site-unit certificate, no gate, no shift. ALREADY CITED (shahbazi2026hierarchical).

papers.title: Certify or Refuse: A Cross-Model Map for Selective Risk Control with Coverage Floors under Covariate Shift
papers.authors: Jiamiao Liu, Dewen Qiao, Yu Zhang, Xuetao Chen
papers.why: Certified selective predictor that must answer at least a beta-fraction of shifted target traffic with at most an alpha-fraction wrong; proves a Floor Certification Map with lower/upper bounds under bounded-ratio covariate shift, sample complexity additive in labeled-source (risk) and unlabeled-target (floor) resources. Same 'certify or refuse' posture and shift-aware certificate as CertGate's decline branch, but covariate not label shift, record-level, QA datasets, no betting. NOT in references.bib -- four days old at check time; a reviewer in this lane may raise it.

papers.title: LEC: Linear Expectation Constraints for Selection-Conditioned Risk Control in Selective Prediction and Routing Systems
papers.authors: Zhiyuan Wang, Aniri, Tianlong Chen, Yue Zhang, Heng Tao Shen, Xiaoshuang Shi, Kaidi Xu
papers.why: Reframes selective prediction as a linear expectation constraint over selection and error indicators, giving finite-sample conditions on a calibration set for accepted-prediction error <= alpha, and extends to two-model routing. A peer-reviewed (ICML 2026) selection-conditioned risk-control paper on the same guarantee target as component (2); no sites, no e-values/betting, no clinical data, no shift. NOT in references.bib.

papers.title: Cross-Domain Uncertainty Quantification for Selective Prediction: A Comprehensive Bound Ablation with Transfer-Informed Betting
papers.why: Ablates nine finite-sample bound families (incl. WSR betting confidence sequences) for selective-prediction risk control across source-target domain shifts and proposes warm-starting the WSR wealth process from a source-domain risk profile, proving the process remains a supermartingale under any divergence. Overlaps the betting-certificate-for-a-selective-gate-under-shift combination; record-level, intent-classification benchmarks, no clinical data, no label-shift correction. NOT in references.bib; lower priority than the two above.

papers.title: Active, anytime-valid risk controlling prediction sets
papers.authors: Ziyu Xu, Nikos Karampatziakis, Paul Mineiro
papers.why: Extends RCPS to the sequential/adaptive setting with anytime-valid guarantees built on a betting wealth process (test-supermartingale), plus a label-query budget. Establishes the RCPS-by-betting lineage that CertGate's certificate sits in; no clusters, no clinical data, no selective gate in CertGate's sense. NOT in references.bib -- worth a citation next to Waudby-Smith & Ramdas / RCPS.

papers.title: Multi-Source Conformal Inference Under Distribution Shift
papers.authors: Yi Liu, Alexander W. Levis, Sharon-Lise Normand, Larry Han
papers.why: Distribution-free prediction intervals for a target population from multiple biased hospital sources with privacy constraints; efficient-influence-function estimation, data-adaptive source weighting; pediatric cardiac-surgery LOS case study. Multi-hospital conformal with shift, but asymptotic (parametric-rate) coverage, regression intervals, no gate, no site-as-exchangeable-unit certificate. NOT in references.bib.

papers.title: Development and Validation of an Interpretable Conformal Predictor to Predict Sepsis Mortality Risk (CPMORS)
papers.why: Mondrian conformal predictor for ICU sepsis mortality with clinician-review abstention, externally validated on the Philips eICU database (error 11.8% vs 43.8% for point predictions; 38.6% flagged). Prior conformal + eICU + abstention work in a clinical journal; record-level, empirical error rather than a finite-sample answered-set certificate, no shift correction. NOT in references.bib.

papers.title: Selection by prediction with conformal p-values
papers.venue: Journal of Machine Learning Research 24 (2023); arXiv 2210.01408; companion: Model-free selective inference under covariate shift via weighted conformal p-values, Biometrika 2025
papers.why: The multiple-testing root of the selective-with-guarantee lane (FDR-controlled selection via conformal p-values, later weighted for covariate shift) on which SCoRE and the selection-conditioned risk-control papers build. Record-level, no clinical validation, no betting; a reviewer from this lane may expect it in the related-work lineage. NOT in references.bib.
